title: Titans
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.91 Numbered Discourses 4.91
  • 10. Asuravagga 10. Titans

Asurasutta Titans

“Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ. “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world. Katame cattāro? What four?

  1. Asuro asuraparivāro, A titan surrounded by titans,
  2. asuro devaparivāro, a titan surrounded by gods,
  3. devo asuraparivāro, a god surrounded by titans, and
  4. devo devaparivāro. a god surrounded by gods.

Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro? And how is an individual a titan surrounded by titans? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisāpissa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā. It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character, and their followers are the same. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti asuraparivāro. That’s how an individual is a titan surrounded by titans.

Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro? And how is an individual a titan surrounded by gods? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā. It’s when an individual is unethical, of bad character, but their followers are ethical, of good character. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo asuro hoti devaparivāro. That’s how an individual is a titan surrounded by gods.

Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro? And how is an individual a god surrounded by titans? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisā ca khvassa hoti dussīlā pāpadhammā. It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character, but their followers are unethical, of bad character. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti asuraparivāro. That’s how an individual is a god surrounded by titans.

Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti devaparivāro? And how is an individual a god surrounded by gods? Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sīlavā hoti kalyāṇadhammo, parisāpissa hoti sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā. It’s when an individual is ethical, of good character, and their followers are the same. Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo devo hoti, devaparivāro. That’s how an individual is a god surrounded by gods.

Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti. These are the four individuals found in the world.”

Paṭhamaṁ.
